text:
Renee (CSM): Hi all — kickoff for HarborCloud onboarding. High level: wire their service to Redwood hosted inference, validate Okta SAML SSO, forward generation audit logs to their Splunk index, and run a 30-day pilot with a 3k/day token cap. Need stakeholder list, timeline, and success criteria.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I can own the integration playbook and the test harness. Recommend 1 week discovery, 2 weeks integration, then 30-day pilot.
Lina (Onboard PM): I'll draft milestones and weekly check-ins. Who at HarborCloud owns IAM and logs?
Marta (Client IT): Marta here. IAM is handled by our platform team (Diego), Splunk is managed by Ops (Ivy). We can commit 2 dev-days during integration.
Vik (Security): Note HarborCloud touches customer PII. Before prod we need SOC2 attestation, a simple dataflow diagram, and confirmation of encryption at rest. I'll send the checklist.
Renee (CSM): Proposed success criteria: 1) SSO via SAML with a test user login, 2) generation audit events visible in Splunk, 3) acceptance test suite >=95% on seed prompts, 4) pilot 95th pctl latency <350ms, 5) no P0s for 7 days.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Also include output-stability checks for top prompts and a curl smoke example for their infra: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"ping"}'
Lina (Onboard PM): Workshop options: Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. I'll block 60m and capture action items.
Marta (Client IT): Wed 10am PT works; Diego and Ivy will join.
calendar-bot: Event created: "HarborCloud 0d Onboarding Kickoff" Wed 10:00-11:00 PT. Attendees: Renee, Omar, Lina, Vik, Marta, Diego, Ivy.
Renee (CSM): Risks: if SOC2/SSO delays push >45 days we should flag renewal risk and escalate. Action items: Omar -> playbook draft (3d), Vik -> security checklist (48h), Lina -> milestone tracker + invite (done).
Omar (Solutions Eng): Will post playbook link and test harness repo by EOD.
Vik (Security): Checklist sent to Marta. Please attach dataflow diagram when available.
Marta (Client IT): Will share Okta metadata and Splunk index details during the workshop.
Renee (CSM): I'll run weekly pilot health checks and capture feedback; if we see early wins we'll loop in Renewals mid-pilot. :rocket:
